description: This file defines the MetaData class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It provides JSON serialization for version, service, channel, bridge, server, subsystem, and COMRPC data structures, along with service metadata interfaces and a template for service metadata implementation. The file is used for describing and managing plugin metadata, including versioning, service states, channels, and inter-process communication proxies.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Main class holding plugin metadata information, including version, services, channels, bridges, server info, and app version.

classes.name: MetaData::Version
classes.description: Represents version information with hash, major, minor, and patch components.

classes.name: MetaData::Service
classes.description: Contains service state, version, module, interface versions, and statistics.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel
classes.description: Represents communication channels with remote address, state, activity status, ID, and name.

classes.name: MetaData::Bridge
classes.description: Represents a bridge with locator, latency, model, and security flag.

classes.name: MetaData::Server
classes.description: Holds server-related data including thread pool, pending requests, and minion info.

classes.name: MetaData::Server::Minion
classes.description: Represents a minion with ID, job, and run count.

classes.name: MetaData::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems and their availability.

classes.name: MetaData::COMRPC
classes.description: Contains remote link and list of proxies for COM RPC communication.

classes.name: MetaData::COMRPC::Proxy
classes.description: Represents a proxy with interface ID, instance ID, and reference count.

methods.name: Version() constructor
methods.description: Initializes version with default values and adds JSON fields.

methods.name: Bridge(const string& text, const uint32_t latency, const string& model, const bool secure)
Server() constructor
methods.description: Initializes server with empty thread pool and pending requests.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Clears thread pool and pending requests.

methods.name: COMRPC() constructor
methods.description: Initializes COMRPC with empty link and proxies.
